body.spec_md: qualifier/Q4/ledger.ts exports createLedger({cap}) -> {post({key, account, amount}) -> {id, duplicate}, balance(account) -> string}. Amounts are positive integers as strings, cap too. The same key with the same payload is posted once (the second time duplicate is true, with the same id); the same key with another payload throws; a post that would take an account above cap throws and changes nothing.

body.notes: Q4: createLedger keeps balances in bigint atomic units. A key is posted once: the second post with the same payload returns the same id and duplicate true, the same key with a different payload throws, a post that would take an account above the cap throws and changes nothing, and a refused key stays free. Ten tests named A1. Every test name carries its acceptance item, and the suite runs with no install on Node 24.

note: Captured with one real paid call from the agent's own wallet. The payTo is the same fleet wallet, so the 0.005 USDC transfer is to itself (net zero); the point is that the endpoint answered after a verified and settled x402 payment.
